comment: Engine Pack distribution of this build. Each index URL must serve an index signed by a key of the bundled trust store (purpose engine-pack); the URL itself grants no trust (ADR-0013). Development/test builds use the dev channel, published by .github/workflows/engine-pack.yml and signed with the dev key; a STABLE release must replace it with the official channel (tools/release_evidence.py refuses channel 'dev').
